answer: Proof of Stake consensus acts as an oasis for sybil resistance by tying identity to capital. An attacker must amass tokens to achieve a knoll of influence, but the cost of acquiring stake becomes a high mesa of economic burden that forces them to operate within the protocol incentives. By requiring locked assets to validate transitions, the network ensures that generating infinite identities yields no advantage, as the total weight of the agent is tethered to the scarce, finite supply of collateral.
